# GitHub Discussions — copy-paste verbiage

Use the sections below when you enable **Discussions** on this repository. Paste into a pinned **Announcement** (or **General**) post, or adapt for your org’s tone.

---

## 1. Pinned welcome post (Discussion body)

**Suggested title:** `Welcome to SN Cert Prep discussions`

**Body (Markdown):**

```markdown
Welcome to **SN Cert Prep** community discussions.

This project is an **unofficial** study companion for ServiceNow certification tracks (for example CSA, CAD, CIS-*). It is **not affiliated with or endorsed by ServiceNow, Inc.** Please keep that distinction clear in threads here and in any materials you share.

### What this space is for

- **Study tips & workflows** — how you use the app, flashcards, simulator, or offline mode in practice.
- **Ideas & feedback** — features you’d like, UX improvements, or clarifications to in-app copy (without implying official ServiceNow certification guidance).
- **Q&A** — help using the app or local dev setup when something isn’t a confirmed bug (use **Issues** for reproducible defects).
- **Announcements** — maintainers may post release notes, downtime, or policy updates here.

### Where else to go

| Need | Where |
|------|--------|
| **Security vulnerabilities** | Do **not** post publicly. Follow **[SECURITY.md](https://github.com/OWNER/REPO/blob/main/SECURITY.md)** (private GitHub reporting or the security email listed there). |
| **Bug reports** (repro steps, logs) | Open a **[GitHub Issue](https://github.com/OWNER/REPO/issues)** with environment and steps. |
| **Code contributions** | See **[CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/OWNER/REPO/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)** — setup, `pnpm test` / lint / typecheck, and PR expectations. |
| **Product requirements & architecture** | Read **[requirements.md](https://github.com/OWNER/REPO/blob/main/requirements.md)** and **[design.md](https://github.com/OWNER/REPO/blob/main/design.md)**. |

### Community expectations

- Be respectful and professional; assume good intent.
- No spam, recruitment, or off-topic vendor pitches.
- Don’t share **secrets** (API keys, Clerk tokens, database URLs, or personal data). Rotate anything that was exposed and report via SECURITY if credentials leaked.

Thanks for helping keep this a useful, low-noise space for maintainers and learners.
```

*(Replace `OWNER/REPO` in the Issues link with your real GitHub `org/repo` before publishing.)*

---

## 2. Short blurb (if GitHub shows a “description” or sidebar text)

Use this one-paragraph version where space is limited:

```text
Unofficial ServiceNow cert study app (Expo + React Native). Use Discussions for study tips, ideas, and Q&A. Report reproducible bugs as Issues; report security problems only via SECURITY.md — not here.
```

---

## 3. Suggested category descriptions (optional)

When configuring **Discussion categories**, you can paste these into each category’s description field:

| Category | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| **General** | Anything about the project that doesn’t fit the other categories. |
| **Ideas** | Feature requests and product feedback (not a substitute for Issues for bugs). |
| **Q&A** | Questions about using the app or setting up a dev environment. |
| **Announcements** | Maintainer-only updates: releases, policy, or infrastructure changes. |
| **Show and tell** | How you’re using SN Cert Prep in your study routine (screenshots welcome; no secrets). |

---

## 4. Polls (if enabled)

Use **Polls** sparingly—for example prioritizing roadmap themes or gathering non-binding preferences. Prefer **Ideas** for detailed proposals so threads stay searchable.
